title: How Trump Is Making the US Poorer: Top Economist Explains
author: John Harwood
content:
War, immigration crackdown, tariffs, broken alliances, and a shredded rule of
law: economist **Justin Wolfers** joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** to unpack
all the ways President Donald Trump is damaging the American economy. Some
consequences are obvious now; others will show up later.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Watch the **full video above** to hear Wolfers discuss whether gas prices will
go back to normal, at what point national debt will be too big to bear, and
how much power the president _actually_ has over the economy.
